subject: DPA: service-provider scope, onshore fallback & subprocessor evidence (HorizonCare)
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@horizoncare.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@horizoncare.com, HorizonCare Legal <legal@horizoncare.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: DPA questions: CCPA/CPRA classification, onshore fallback, and subprocessor evidence

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking this — HorizonCare is running through our DPA checklist ahead of a potential pilot. We have a few items that need confirmation so our privacy team can sign off: 

1) Classification: our legal team needs explicit confirmation Redwood will act as a "Service Provider" (CCPA/CPRA) and not as a "Business" for data we provide. Please point us to the clause in your standard DPA you rely on for this.

2) Subprocessors: provide a current subprocessor inventory and clarify which subprocessors handle telemetry or cached prefixes. We need any onshore (US) fallbacks documented for critical subprocessors.

3) Onshore fallback / residency: for regulated derivatives (PHI-adjacent telemetry), we need a written onshore fallback plan and evidence of ability to failover within the US if offshore subprocessors become unavailable.

4) Evidence: SOC 2 AOC (most-recent), a redacted dataflow diagram that shows telemetry paths, and any templated addenda you use for state-level carveouts.

Please let us know the estimated timeline to provide these items. We are hoping to move to contracting in the next 2 weeks, so a prompt turnaround would be appreciated. I have attached our DPA questionnaire so you can mark up where needed.

Regards,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Regulatory
HorizonCare
Attachments: horizoncare_dpa_questionnaire.xlsx

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@horizoncare.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-23T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA questions: CCPA/CPRA classification, onshore fallback, and subprocessor evidence

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Quick responses inline and next steps below.

On classification: Redwood's standard DPA and our US privacy addendum designate us as a "Service Provider" under CCPA/CPRA for customer-provided data; we do not take ownership or monetize customer data. See section 2.1 (Roles) of our standard DPA.

Subprocessors: attaching our current inventory (redwood_subprocessor_inventory_20270523.csv). We have flagged those handling telemetry/cache specifically in the note column. For any subprocessor that is primarily offshore, we maintain an onshore fallback for critical paths — details below.

Onshore fallback / residency: attaching a short playbook (redwood_onshore_fallback_playbook.pdf) that describes our policy and failover steps, typical RTOs, and example onshore fallback providers. In brief: for regulated telemetry we pin to onshore pools (Dedicated or Private), and for Hosted we use routing policies plus our onshore fallback cluster to avoid cross-border processing when requested.

Evidence: attaching our SOC 2 AOC (redwood-soc2-aoc-2026.pdf) and a redacted dataflow diagram (contained in the playbook).

Next steps: 
- We can redline HorizonCare's questionnaire and return the draft DPA within 3 business days — does that timeline work?
- If you prefer a live walkthrough, Laura (CC'd) can join to go over the playbook and the subprocessor inventory.

Let me know whether you need the subprocessor inventory in a signed attestation format (we can provide that under NDA).

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Privacy & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_subprocessor_inventory_20270523.csv; redwood_onshore_fallback_playbook.pdf; redwood-soc2-aoc-2026.pdf

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-24T08:09:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: DPA questions: HorizonCare — tech checklist and sanitized telemetry mapping

Naomi — forwarding Elena's thread. A couple of operational asks from infra before we send formal evidence: 

- Can we provide a sanitized telemetry mapping that lists categories (e.g., prefix KV cache, model usage logs, routing metadata) rather than raw identifiers? HorizonCare will accept categories but asked for clarity on which subprocessors touch each category.
- Please confirm the RTO numbers shown in the playbook are accurate for Hosted (we quoted < 30s for failover to onshore fallback clusters). If that is optimistic, let's update before sending.
- Add a brief paragraph clarifying that cached prefixes are considered transient telemetry and are purged per our retention schedule unless customer requests otherwise.

I added a link to the internal playbook draft: https://drive.redwood.internal/privacy/onshore-fallback-playbook — please add the sanitized telemetry table as a sheet in the subprocessor CSV.

Grace
Director, Product Ops

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@horizoncare.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@horizoncare.com, HorizonCare Legal <legal@horizoncare.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA questions: CCPA/CPRA classification, onshore fallback, and subprocessor evidence

Naomi — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few follow-ups: 

- The SOC 2 AOC and the subprocessor inventory look fine. We will need a short signed attestation that the inventory was accurate as of the date provided; can you produce that on company letterhead?
- The onshore fallback playbook is helpful — procurement wants a one‑page summary we can attach to the PO that lists the specific US providers we will rely on for fallback. Could you produce that?
- Regarding classification language, our counsel will still send a couple of redlines to your DPA (mostly around the carveout language for de‑identified telemetry and the definition of "Service Provider"). Please send a DocuSign-ready DPA and we will return redlines.

We are available for a 30-minute call Friday at 10am PT if you prefer to walk through the attachments. If you can produce the signed attestation and the one‑page fallback list before then, that would accelerate our contracting.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Regulatory
HorizonCare
Attachments: horizoncare_dpa_questionnaire.xlsx (original)

-- Attachment stubs referenced in thread --
redwood_subprocessor_inventory_20270523.csv (CSV listing - columns: name, role, country, touches_telemetry:boolean, note)
redwood_onshore_fallback_playbook.pdf (PDF - internal playbook: failover steps, RTO targets, example onshore providers)
redwood-soc2-aoc-2026.pdf (PDF - SOC 2 AOC, redacted)
horizoncare_dpa_questionnaire.xlsx (XLSX - HorizonCare DPA questionnaire)
